name: Actions Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Actions Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a fabless semiconductor enterprise, specializing in the development and production of integrated Systems-on-Chip (SoCs) tailored for the portable multimedia market within China. Its product offerings include integrated circuits vital for Bluetooth wearables, speakers, and transmitters, as well as solutions for portable audio-visual devices, smart multimedia applications, and Bluetooth voice-controlled remotes. Founded in 2014, the company's main office is located in Zhuhai, China.
